meta.title: A caller without update permission is refused
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
The available setup does not create a caller in neither branch; EDGE-PUB-016 covers a vendor caller without event update permission instead.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
